newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ MP KIRTON TO REMAIN IN NZ FIRST CAUCUS - PETERS.
newsitem.headline: NZ MP KIRTON TO REMAIN IN NZ FIRST CAUCUS - PETERS.

text.p: Sacked New Zealand associate health minister Neil Kirton has said he will remain in the New Zealand First party's caucus, Deputy Prime Minister Winston Peters said on Tuesday.
"We had a very free and frank discussion...people did not hold back on anything they had to say including Mr Kirton," Peters told a news conference.
"He has said he wants to stay and remain in caucus and caucus is unanimous in wanting him to stay as well," Peters said.
Kirton said his vote was secure and he would be a full member of the coalition government.
